dev.title: Developer Documentation
dev.description: API and endpoint documentation to integrate Yoto icons into your applications.
dev.quickstartContent: Icons are accessible via static JSON files served from GitHub Pages. No API key required.
dev.endpointsIntro: All endpoints are served via HTTPS with CORS enabled (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).
dev.endpointSummaryFilesDesc: Detailed manifests by category and by source.
dev.endpointSearchIndexDesc: Pre-generated Lunr.js index for client-side full-text search.
dev.endpointCombinedDesc: All icons merged into a single file (useful for full sync).
dev.schemaIconDesc: An icon contains: id, source, title, artist, tags, category, subcategory, downloads, preview_image, download_url, date_added, license, metadata.
dev.schemaSummaryDesc: The summary contains total counts, by source, by category, and the list of authors with their counters.
dev.performanceContent: Files are served via GitHub Pages (global CDN). The search index (~50 KB) is browser-cached. Use the Lunr index for local search without network requests.
dev.versioningContent: Endpoint URLs are stable. Existing fields are never removed; only new fields may be added.
dev.stabilityContent: The API follows implicit semantic versioning: breaking changes would increment the URL (e.g., /v2/).
dev.licenceContent: Icons come from three sources with their respective licenses: YotoPixels (CC-BY-SA), YotoIcons (CC-BY-NC), Yoto Official (Yoto).
dev.attributionContent: For YotoPixels and YotoIcons, credit the author (@handle) and the source. For Yoto Official, credit Yoto.
dev.contentsContent: Data includes metadata, color palette, preview and download URLs. No personal data.
dev.resourceApiSourceDesc: Astro/Node endpoints generating static JSON files.
dev.resourceTypesDesc: Interface definitions for Icon, IconSummary, IconMetadata, etc.
dev.resourceReportBugDesc: Open a GitHub issue for any data or API problem.
